scope: Local Rust/CUDA only. No commits, pushes, deployments or uploads.
purpose: Explain low scalar-MLP training accuracy, including deeper networks, while retaining the original residual ablation and full scalar grid.
prerequisite: Finish experiments/local-residual-regression.json with its frozen binary before scheduling additional GPU trials.

controls.selection: Inspect train fit on smaller tasks and subsets. These controls do not replace full-modulus-97 experiments.

deep.selection: For each operation/scale task, retain the best finite screen by train RMSE and the best by held-out RMSE; deduplicate configurations and run all three seeds. Report both selection criteria explicitly.

adaptiveFollowup.purpose: Use control and deep-network evidence to choose matched optimization and capacity follow-ups, rather than interpreting a failed initial grid as an impossibility result.
adaptiveFollowup.biasControl: Keep every Kaiming matrix identical. Uniform and domain modes use identical later-layer biases; domain changes only the first-layer bias rule to place hinges through the operand box.
adaptiveFollowup.rule: Save each concrete follow-up configuration and its reason before launch; use matched seeds and update budgets for causal comparisons.

reporting: Record final and peak logged train accuracy, held-out accuracy, residue RMSE, update counts, divergence and initialization/source hashes. Distinguish memorization from generalization and finite-budget evidence from representational impossibility.
